problem.currency: Send an ISO 4217 currency code, such as USD, EUR or GBP.
problem.domain: “{domain}” isn't a domain. Send one like app.acme.io, without https:// or a path.
problem.domainsNeeded: Add the domains the click token goes on, such as app.acme.io.
problem.idempotencyKey: The Idempotency-Key header can be up to 200 characters.
problem.idempotencyReuse: This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different conversion. Use a new key for each conversion.
problem.missingIdentity: Send the reader's email, the click token (rc_click), or both.
problem.name: Name the conversion, such as “Upgraded to Team plan”.
problem.occurredAt: occurred_at must be within the last 30 days and not in the future. Send the time it happened.
problem.rateLimited: This key is sending conversions too fast. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
problem.value: Send the value as a decimal string, such as “29.00”, not 29.
problem.valueDecimals: The value has more decimals than its currency.
problem.window: Pick a window from 1 to 30 days.

test.name.note: the name of a test conversion sent from Earn › Settings › Attribution
